questions.question: In the Parable of the Rich Fool, what did God say to the rich man?
options: You fool, tonight your soul is required of you
Store up still more, and your soul shall have rest
Share your grain freely with all your neighbors
Well done, you have been faithful with little
questions.answer: You fool, tonight your soul is required of you
